tiles.label: Rev dial
tiles.css: .tile { justify-content: center; align-items: center; } .gauge { position: relative; width: 86%; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; } .gauge-arc { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(from 220deg, var(--accent) calc(var(--rpm-ratio) * 280deg), rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0); mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 62%, #000 63%); } .gauge-needle { position: absolute; width: 2px; height: 38%; bottom: 50%; transform-origin: bottom center; transform: rotate(calc(-140deg + var(--rpm-ratio) * 280deg)); background: var(--accent-alt); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-alt); transition: transform 90ms linear; } .gauge-value { font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 22cqh, 2rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .gauge-unit { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); }

tiles.label: Temperature threshold
tiles.css: .hot-label { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); } .hot-value { font-size: clamp(1rem, 34cqh, 2.4rem); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: color-mix(in srgb, #ff4d4d calc(var(--coolant-ratio) * 130%), var(--accent)); } .hot-bar { height: 5px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .hot-fill { height: 100%; width: calc(var(--coolant-ratio) * 100%); background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff4d4d calc(var(--coolant-ratio) * 130%), var(--accent)); transition: width 120ms linear; }
